# MOEMOI Claims Register — INDEX (generated-style; the per-claim files are the source)

*TL;DR: one line per claim, C1-C81. The WRITABLE SOURCE for every claim is its file in `Registers/Claims/` — update there, never here. This index and the xlsx are MIRRORS, regenerated by `tools/los_skill/scripts/claims_regen.py` (FX-1/B319; `--check` = the drift tripwire, `--write` = rebuild). Pre-adoption candidates live ONLY in the Held-Index. Full pre-B318 history (every dated update block, verbatim): `Registers/Archive/MOEMOI_Claims_Register_UpdateLog_2026-05-30_to_2026-06-10.md`.*

**What this register is:** the single tracked log of every claim/hypothesis MOEMOI makes — MOEMOI's own belief data structure applied reflexively to itself, and one operational measure of its own intelligence (how many claims are answered, and how well). Everything here is a **claim** (a "hypothesis" is just a claim not yet well-supported).

**Confidence scale:** Working assumption (act on it, not proven) · Hypothesis (plausible, untested) · Observed-pattern (empirical support, not proven for all cases) · Definitional-frame (true by definition / a lens, not falsifiable) · Open tension (unresolved conflict) · Well-supported.

**The B318 architecture (10 Jun 2026 — FX-1/FX-2, from the CB-38 audit):**

- ONE writable surface per claim: `Registers/Claims/C<n>.md` — live state updated in place + a dated history inside each file.
- This index + `MOEMOI_Claims_Register.xlsx` = generated mirrors. Never hand-edit them.
- ONE ID grammar: anything ADOPTED gets the next sequential C# — period. Proposal-era IDs (C-B###, C-HARV-XX#, C-KC#) become `proposed_as:` provenance fields, permanently findable via aliases.
- Pre-adoption items have NO C-number: they exist ONLY as Held-Index rows (`MOEMOI_Held_Register_Notes_Index_B175_1_v1.xlsx`) — the single enumerable pre-adoption surface. Evidence-notes are Held-Index rows of class "evidence".
- The fold-invariant (FX-3): any canonical fold / register pass reads EXACTLY ONE pre-adoption surface — the Held-Index. Anything not in it does not exist for the fold.
- Decision packets are generated on demand from the Held-Index (the static packet is superseded — see its banner).
- The 6 Jun ratification (Decision Packet, Josh's blanket adoption) + the 10 Jun C-KC1 adoption are reflected here: C66-C81 are ADOPTED with confidence levels unchanged by adoption.

## How this register is used

- Every new ADOPTED claim gets the next sequential C# + its own file in `Registers/Claims/`.
- Every new CANDIDATE goes to the Held-Index (never numbered, never a quasi-claim in prose).
- Confidence and status are revised as evidence accumulates — in the per-claim file, with a dated history line.
- "Survived / revised / iterated" is tracked per claim over time, in-file.
- The register doubles as a measure of MOEMOI's own intelligence: how many claims are answered, and how qualitatively.

## Candidate Batch (22 Jun 2026) — B-IP-AS-OS, IPU-1, B-FEP

**C91 (CANDIDATE, HIGH confidence) — The IP is the specification of a great Life Operating System**
The Intelligence Process (IP) is not just a theory of intelligence; it is the SPECIFICATION of what a great operating system for life must implement. An OS is judged by how well it enables the processes it runs; a great life OS is judged by how well it enables the IP (the process of becoming more optimal). This reframes the LOS/CoLive product: CoLive is not delivering a to-do system or a habit tracker -- it is implementing the IP for the user. Every LOS feature maps to an IP substep: task management → D ring; habit tracking → P ring and A ring; value clarification → PR ring; daily brief → S ring; learning capture → A ring. The IP is the OS's specification, not just its inspiration.
